steps.text: a control structure where RESP-1 has PM-1-1, CA-1-1, and FB-1-1
structural heuristics are checked
the heuristic check passes with no errors

scenarios.name: SP1-HEUR-02 responsibility missing an element type fails

steps.text: a responsibility RESP-1 with zero <element_type>
structural heuristics are checked
the heuristic check fails with error containing <error_fragment>

scenarios.name: SP1-HEUR-03 orphan PM not updated by any feedback produces warning

steps.text: a responsibility RESP-1 with PM-1-1 and PM-1-2 where only PM-1-1 is updated by FB-1-1
structural heuristics are checked
a warning is produced for orphan PM PM-1-2

scenarios.name: SP1-HEUR-04 controlled process not referenced by any feedback or CA fails

steps.text: a controlled process CP-1 not referenced by any feedback channel source or control action target
structural heuristics are checked
the heuristic check fails with error containing controlled process

scenarios.name: SP1-HEUR-05 hazard not traced to any responsibility fails

steps.text: a loss analysis with hazard H-1 and constraint SC-1
a control structure where no responsibility references constraint SC-1
structural heuristics are checked with the loss analysis
the heuristic check fails with error containing hazard

scenarios.name: SP1-HEUR-06 hazard traced to a responsibility passes

steps.text: a loss analysis with hazard H-1 and constraint SC-1
a control structure where responsibility RESP-1 references constraint SC-1
structural heuristics are checked with the loss analysis
the heuristic check passes with no errors

scenarios.name: SP1-HEUR-07 heuristics run automatically after Call 3 assembly

steps.text: an LLM that returns valid responses for all three Stage 2 calls
Stage 2 control structure derivation is run
structural heuristics are checked on the assembled ControlStructure
the heuristic results are available

scenarios.name: SP1-HEUR-08 heuristics are re-run after revision

steps.text: a control structure that fails structural heuristics
a revision call that produces a corrected control structure
the revision is applied
structural heuristics are re-run on the revised ControlStructure

scenarios.name: SP1-HEUR-09 heuristic errors after revision are flagged but pipeline proceeds

steps.text: a revision call that produces a control structure with a structural error
the revision is applied
the structural error is flagged in the run manifest
the pipeline proceeds without looping
